narratives.Problem: Greenfield setup, export, PRD, cost, and build use incompatible assumptions about whether authority is xbrief/specification.xbrief.json or xbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json plus lifecycle scopes. The mismatch hides proposed scopes, emits false provenance, breaks PRD rendering, and traps setup-to-build behind an impossible cost prerequisite.
narratives.Change: Centralize two-path authority and dynamic provenance, preserve stakeholder and explicit no-scope compact output, default omitted internal scope selection to proposed-only, make PRD greenfield-aware without scope leakage, and align setup/interview/cost/build guidance through the canonical skills pack.
narratives.Scope: In scope: #3598 runtime semantics, PRD authority resolution, generated provenance, exact-command CLI tests, canonical setup/interview/cost/build pack content, rendered skills, content-contract tests, and release notes. Out of scope: creating a greenfield specification artifact, weakening full-spec support, a path-only validator ban, or merging the PR.
narratives.Impact: Touches the shared spec-authority resolver, spec and PRD renderers/CLIs, authority and render tests, the skills pack and rendered skill projections, content-contract tests, xBRIEF scope metadata, and CHANGELOG.md.
narratives.Risks: Collapsing omitted scope selection into explicit off would break the locked override contract; broad internal defaults could leak pending or active work; reusing lifecycle scopes in PRD could leak planning state; naive strategy validation could reject valid full-spec projects; generated skill edits could drift from their pack source.
narratives.Approach: Land three ordered slices in one PR: first distinguish omitted/off scope policy and emit source-path provenance; second route project-root PRD through shared authority while excluding lifecycle scopes; third update canonical skill-pack journey and split executable integration coverage from content contracts. Keep runtime support ahead of prose and run pack render/check, targeted tests, forward coverage, coverage hotspots, and task check.
narratives.Alternatives: Teaching every caller extra flags was rejected because it leaves renderer semantics contradictory. Creating xbrief/specification.xbrief.json for greenfield was rejected because it restores the dual-write defect. Removing PRD from setup was rejected because shared authority can support it. A path-only validator prohibition was rejected because full-spec consumers are valid.
narratives.Dependencies: Existing resolveSpecAuthority/resolveExportNarratives behavior, project export and PRD CLI surfaces, the canonical skills pack renderer, the #3598 consolidated plan, and the current xBRIEF lifecycle gates.
narratives.Confirmation: Flynn explicitly approved the named change 3598-greenfield-handoff-authority on 2026-08-26.
